svg.text: Initialised up to 8A56, then uninitialised: ds:8000 to FFE4
8A57: from here the file holds zeros
C0 start-up data: the copyright string and the two runtime
14 text-window regions (16 bytes), 8 option panels (16 bytes)
tables and strings: names, spells, monsters, walls
screen node records on a 60-byte grid (section 5.10)
view geometry, camp and dialog data, strings, file names
graphics driver entry points (802A), flags, mouse and video state
clocks and the 24-bit RNG state (8484, 8488 to 849E)
PC speaker and Tandy driver data
gMonsters: 30 records of 28 bytes (zero in the file)
the 64-byte block of the saved game (section 5.11)
